---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a change to Eden
---

**The problem** — what you are trying to do and where Eden falls short.

**The proposal** — what should change. Before proposing an approach already
rejected, check [docs/DEAD-ENDS.md](../docs/DEAD-ENDS.md) and
[docs/DECISIONS.md](../docs/DECISIONS.md).

**How it would be measured** — Eden changes land behind measurements; name the
eval, suite or benchmark that would show the change is better.
